location.description: The location in which the encryptionSpec is to be initialized.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: References the project in which the encryption specification is created. Platform policy should not constrain team-specific project identifiers or references.

encryption_spec.kms_key.description:
The name of customer-managed encryption key that is used to secure a resource and its sub-resources.
If empty, the resource is secured by the default Google encryption key.
Only the key in the same location as this resource is allowed to be used for encryption.
Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{keyRing}/cryptoKeys/{key}
encryption_spec.kms_key.rationale: Sets the customer-managed encryption key used to protect the resource and its sub-resources. A policy should require this value to be non-empty so customer-managed encryption is used instead of the default Google-managed key; it must not require a specific key because keys are team and project specific.
